example_sentences_in_bangla: সে খুব ভেতো মানুষ, সামান্য ভয়েই পালিয়ে যায়।
যুদ্ধের সময় তার ভেতো স্বভাব প্রকাশ পেয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a very timid person and runs away at the slightest fear.
His cowardly nature was revealed during the war.
note: This term is more of a descriptive adjective than a complex idiom, commonly used in colloquial Bengali to denote inner weakness.
